dataset.target: logged rbf_output_raw at attitude event k; post-dmax/pre-beta; rad/s^2

feature_contract.wrapped_attitude_error_formula: atan2(sin(filtered_attitude_reference - state_euler), cos(filtered_attitude_reference - state_euler)) at each attitude event
feature_contract.body_rate_source: body rates in logged state at the same attitude event
feature_contract.nominal_torque_source: logged attitude_bs_nominal_torque_Nm at the same attitude event
feature_contract.morph_command_source: logged dimensionless morph_command x4 at the same attitude event

initialization.construction: torch.manual_seed(seed), CPU GRU15 construction, then move to cuda:0

training_contract.cohort_schedule: fixed-seed shuffle, disjoint groups of four scenes, each cohort from event 0 to 1998
training_contract.hidden_state: scene-local carry across chunks, detach every 128 events, reset after event 1998
training_contract.training_events_per_optimizer_step: record actual valid events; padding excluded
training_contract.normalizer_policy: reuse source GRU15 full72 bytes and values; no refit
training_contract.learning_rate_ledger: record applied learning rate on every optimizer-step history row
training_contract.checkpoint_policy: final_step@60000 only; no validation, selection, resume, or extension
